-"},{"id":"p42s3","text":" **Save money.** Moving execution-heavy workloads to a lower-cost DeepSeek route can reduce consumpt"},{"id":"p42s4","text":"ion on more expensive primary models."},{"id":"p43s1","text":"Actual speed and cost depend on the selected model, provider, deployment, network, and task.
